about.heading: About the Market
about.intro: Shire's Farmers Market is open every Saturday from 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM. Located at 3939 Beech Church Road, Coal City, IN 47427 (corner of State Road 157 and Beech Church Road).
about.body: Our 2026 season is officially underway: opening day was Saturday, May 9th! Join us every Saturday for fresh, locally grown produce and homemade goods. Experience the best of Coal City's agricultural and artisan community.
features: Located on the old highschool property

vendors.heading: For Vendors
vendors.intro: Join our community of local farmers and artisans!

cards.title: Booth Space Options
cards.text: $5 canopy-covered space or $15 shelter stalls (12' x 12', 10 available weekly)

cards.title: Covered Vendor Booths
cards.text: Beat the heat in our new, covered, three-sided "saltbox" shed

cards.title: Community Focus
cards.text: Promoting healthy homegrown produce and canned goods to our local community

signup.intro: Ready to join Shire's Farmers Market? Fill out the form below and we'll be in touch! Craft vendors are welcome.
